title: docs: define model PR merge holds and date prefixes
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Documented `MERGE-HOLD` and the `🕒 YYYY-MM-DD |` and `🕒 DATE TBD |` prefixes for model PRs, following the convention used in #16256. Lifting a hold requires explicit release conditions and verified successor pricing; a scheduled date does not authorize an automatic merge. This is workflow guidance only, with no model or billing changes.
